name: econ-war-chest
notes: Exotics v2 gate (2026-10-20). Outside escalation the aliens keep a war chest (12 months of drip, ~700 in 2034): exotic-tier builds read only the stock above it, and capital-hull building tightens as the hoard above it runs down (slack counts (stock - chest) / 60 months). Setup: alien exotics set to 900, just above the chest. Expect: the stock holds near or above the chest for a year; the control (econ-war-chest-control, switch off) spends below it. Context: 2-year soak 2026-10-18 took the stock 2.0k -> 1.3-1.7k, mostly exotic builds; ship upkeep 14 -> 31-44/month.
info: [(e['t'][:7], e['stock']['Exotics'], e['warChest'], round(e['drip'], 1), round(e['upkeep'], 1), e['shipUpkeep'], e['slack'], e['largeFactor'], e['warChestHeld']) for e in events('economy')]
